event.label: Marriage (Vivah)
event.note: This finds generally auspicious days only. The final vivah muhurat must be confirmed by a pandit after matching both Kundlis (lagna, Guru/Shukra and the couple's Chandrabala).

avoided.text: Kharmas: the Sun is in Sagittarius or Pisces, a pause for ceremonies
Rikta tithis (Chaturthi, Navami, Chaturdashi) are traditionally "empty" for new beginnings
Bhadra (Vishti karana) at sunrise is avoided for auspicious work
Amavasya (new Moon) is avoided for auspicious starts

message: No clearly auspicious day in this range for this event. Try a longer range or ask a pandit.
disclaimer: Muhurat suggestions follow widely published Vedic panchang rules (tithi, nakshatra, weekday, yoga, Bhadra, Rahu Kaal) for your area. They are general guidance, not a guarantee, and do not replace your family tradition or a pandit who can also check the exact lagna and your Kundli. Customs vary by region.
